content.comment_body: Hello, I work in IT support within an industrial company. A colleague was using [product_name] [version_no] software and spent around four days on a project without creating any backups. Now, the file will not load and stalls at 98%. Is there any solution for this issue? I appreciate any help.
You could initiate a support request to [company_name] and ask if the file can be inspected and repaired. If that isn't possible, you may need to recreate the program.
Thanks for your prompt reply. I have now contacted [company_name] support regarding this problem. Hopefully, they can fix it.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced project file corruption within [product_name] [version_no], which caused the software to hang at 98% when attempting to load the file. Due to lacking backup practices, there is substantial risk of data loss. Participants displayed limited knowledge of internal recovery options and depended mainly on manufacturer support for potential file restoration.
analysis.user_expectations: The user is seeking a method to recover or repair the corrupted [product_name] project file so it can be accessed without needing to rebuild the project from the beginning.
